title: Reproducible Live-RPC Deployment Correspondence
objective: Produce reproducible, read-only evidence that compares declared deployments with independently observed on-chain data and assigns a correspondence state only when the defined evidence criteria support it.
included_scope: Machine-readable correspondence evidence and verification method
Explicit VERIFIED, PARTIAL, and UNKNOWN state definitions
excluded_scope: Token, liquidity, minting, or asset actions

state_definitions.VERIFIED: A declared deployment has non-empty code independently observed with eth_getCode at the recorded block on the expected chain.
state_definitions.PARTIAL: A declared deployment exists, but the required live-RPC evidence is missing or inconclusive.
state_definitions.UNKNOWN: No declared deployment reference exists for the observed address.

success_criteria: Every evaluated deployment has a machine-readable correspondence state and source references.
Every VERIFIED state includes reproducible declared and independently observed evidence.
PARTIAL and UNKNOWN states preserve the specific missing or inconclusive evidence.
CI rejects unsupported state transitions and incomplete provenance.
The static build and verification checks pass.
